sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that

findings.why: The approved supplier list does cover BR-180 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, but its only approval is for SUP-C. There is no approval for SUP-B (Alluminio Bormida). The SUP-B approvals on the list are for BR-220 and BR-225, and an approval does not carry over to another part. QP-11 4.2 requires an approval for supplier, part, site and customer, so SUP-B cannot deliver BR-180 yet.

sources.quote: after any of: a change of source, a change of material, a change of manufacturing process, or a change

findings.why: BR-180 belongs to PRG-Z, which is an Aurelia program. Adding a second source is a change of source. Aurelia revision 4, which replaces revision 3, requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts, and 7.3 makes that approval specific to part number and site. No approval or deviation from Aurelia covers this change. DEV-114 was for SUP-C and has expired.
